---
title: "Study queue"
output-file: queue.html
---

Add topics to the queue and choose which one runs next. Only one study runs at a time; if you hit the plan limit, progress is saved and you can resume later.

<div id="q-app">
  <form id="q-form" class="q-form"><input id="q-topic" type="text" required minlength="3" maxlength="80" autocomplete="off"><button id="q-add" type="submit"></button></form>
  <p id="q-error" class="q-error" role="alert"></p>

  <h2>Queue</h2>
  <div id="q-list"></div>

  <h2>Running</h2>
  <p id="q-plan" class="q-meta"></p>
  <div id="q-progress"></div>

  <h2>Cost per study</h2>
  <div id="q-usage"></div>
</div>

<script src="/assets/queue.js" data-lang="en"></script>
